paragraphs: Markets over the last day: the eight tracked equity indices moved +0.27% on average, with Nikkei 225 strongest (+0.83%) and Hang Seng weakest (+0.05%). Brent crude changed -4.44% to 110.2. Gold changed +0.06% to 4,054.2. Bitcoin changed -0.60% to 80,317.1094. The US 10-year yield stands at 5.045%, a relative move of +1.04%. Among the firms tracked, Evercore (+12.51%) and Santander (-6.26%) moved the most.
